heading.en: Birth, medical training and entry into politics

body.zh-Hant: 阿努爾福·阿里亞斯·馬德里生於1901年8月15日，1988年8月10日去世，是巴拿馬政治人物，本業為醫生，畢業於哈佛醫學院。1930年他加入民族主義組織「社區行動」（Acción Comunal），一年後領導該組織參與推翻阿羅塞梅納政府的革命。
body.en: Arnulfo Arias Madrid was born on 15 August 1901 and died on 10 August 1988. A Panamanian politician and a medical doctor by profession, he graduated from Harvard Medical School. He joined the nationalistic organization Acción Comunal in 1930 and, a year later, was leading it in the revolution that overthrew the government of Florencio Harmodio Arosemena.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一任總統任內的政策

body.zh-Hant: 阿里亞斯第一次任總統在1940至1941年。他的施政綱領稱為「巴拿馬主義」（panameñismo），意思是「巴拿馬人的巴拿馬」。據該條目，他頒布民族主義憲法、建立社會保險制度、給予婦女投票權並嘗試土地改革，也拒絕讓美國以長期租約取得更多軍事基地用地。
body.en: Arias held his first presidency in 1940–1941. His platform was embodied in what he called panameñismo, translated as "Panama for the Panamanians." According to the entry, he promulgated a nationalistic constitution, created a social security system, gave women the right to vote and attempted a land reform program, and he did not allow the United States to acquire more land for military bases.

citations.quote: three-time president (1940–1941, 1949–1951, 1968)

body.zh-Hant: 1941年他在任期屆滿前遭軍事政變推翻，當時據稱他正試圖延長任期。1949年他發動軍事政變重返權力，1951年再度被推翻並入獄；1968年重新執政，隨後被奧馬爾·托里霍斯領導的運動罷黜。
body.en: In 1941 he was overthrown by a military coup before completing his first term, when he was reportedly trying to extend it. In 1949 he led a military coup and returned to power; in 1951 he was overthrown again and imprisoned. He returned to government in 1968 but was deposed by the movement led by Omar Torrijos.

heading.en: Later opposition to Noriega and legacy

body.zh-Hant: 1980年代中期，阿里亞斯成為反對獨裁者曼努埃爾·安東尼奧·諾列加將軍的主要人物。他的追隨者在1989年美國入侵後掌權，並把他的政黨改名為巴拿馬阿努爾福黨（Arnulfista Party）。
body.en: In the mid-1980s, Arias became the major figure opposing the dictator General Manuel Antonio Noriega. His followers came to power after the 1989 U.S. invasion and renamed his party the Arnulfista Party of Panama.

body.zh-Hant: 西居爾聚爾·埃格茨生於1875年3月1日（哥本哈根登記為2月28日），出生地是冰島西北部的博爾濟埃里（Borðeyri）貿易站。他1895年自雷克雅維克拉丁學校畢業，之後在哥本哈根攻讀法律，1903年取得法學學位。他在哥本哈根求學期間對文學很感興趣，一生都從事詩歌與寫作，作品包括四部劇本。
body.en: Sigurður Eggerz was born on 1 March 1875 (28 February in the Copenhagen record) at the trading post of Borðeyri in north-west Iceland. He finished the Reykjavík Latin School in 1895, then studied law in Copenhagen and qualified as cand. jur. in 1903. During his years in Copenhagen he was very interested in literature, and he engaged in poetry and writing throughout his life; his works include four plays.

heading.zh-Hant: 進入阿爾庭與冰島大臣
heading.en: Election to the Althing and minister for Iceland

body.zh-Hant: 埃格茨1911年以獨立候選人身分當選阿爾庭議員，1914年以獨立黨黨員身分再度當選。該黨在當年選舉獲勝後任命他為新任大臣。當時的核心問題是修改1874年憲法，以及反對冰島法律須送交丹麥國務會議呈請國王；這項要求無法達成，他在第一次國務會議後即須辭職。1916年愛納爾·阿爾瑙森被任命為冰島下一任大臣後，獨立黨分裂。
body.en: Eggerz was elected to the Althing in 1911 as an independent candidate and re-elected in 1914 as a member of the Independence Party. When the party won that year's election it appointed him the new minister. The great issue was amending the constitution of 1874 and opposing the submission of Icelandic laws to the king in the Danish Council of State; since this demand could not be met, he had to resign after his first Council of State meeting. After Einar Arnórsson was appointed Iceland's next minister in 1916, the Independence Party split.

body.zh-Hant: 1917年，埃格茨出任約恩·馬格努松內閣的冰島財政大臣。1918年12月1日冰島取得主權時，約恩·馬格努松人在丹麥，因此由埃格茨負責政府事務，在雷克雅維克正式接受主權。
body.en: In 1917 Eggerz became finance minister in the Icelandic government of Jón Magnússon. When Iceland obtained its sovereignty on 1 December 1918, Jón Magnússon was in Denmark, so it was Eggerz who had charge of the government when sovereignty was officially received in Reykjavík.

Eftersom denne var i Danmark da Island fik sin suverænitet 1.12.1918

body.zh-Hant: 埃格茨自1922年3月7日至1924年3月22日任冰島總理。其後他成為新獨立黨黨員，最後一次出現在阿爾庭是1931年，最後的職務是阿庫雷里（Akureyri）的市法官。他於1945年11月16日在雷克雅維克去世。
body.en: Eggerz was prime minister of Iceland from 7 March 1922 to 22 March 1924. Afterwards he became a member of the new Independence Party; he sat in the Althing for the last time in 1931, and his last post was the office of town magistrate at Akureyri. He died in Reykjavík on 16 November 1945.

body.zh-Hant: 納吉卡洛的卡洛伊·米克洛什1887年1月23日生於薩博爾奇縣的尼賴吉哈佐。1909年他在布達佩斯大學取得國家學博士學位，之後曾到日內瓦、哈勒與巴黎進修。1910年10月1日起任薩博爾奇縣行政實習生，1914年任基什瓦爾達區的區長，後在納吉卡洛區任主任區長；1918年他提前退休，回到卡洛謝姆延的家族田產務農。
body.en: Miklós Kállay of Nagykálló was born on 23 January 1887 at Nyíregyháza in Szabolcs County. In 1909 he took a doctorate in state sciences at the University of Budapest, and he then studied further at Geneva, Halle and Paris. From 1 October 1910 he was an administrative trainee in Szabolcs County; in 1914 he became district magistrate in Kisvárda and later chief district magistrate in Nagykálló. In 1918 he had himself pensioned off and farmed on the family estate at Kállósemjén.

heading.en: County lord-lieutenant, state secretary and agriculture minister

body.zh-Hant: 1922年起，卡洛伊任薩博爾奇縣長（főispán），後來兼轄薩博爾奇與溫格兩縣，直到1929年10月。其後他任商務部政務次官，至1931年8月24日止；1932年10月1日至1935年1月9日出任農業部長，條目稱他在平原植樹和使蒂薩河上游可通航方面有作為。
body.en: From 1922 Kállay was lord-lieutenant (főispán) of Szabolcs County, later of the combined Szabolcs and Ung counties, until October 1929. He then served as political state secretary in the Ministry of Commerce until 24 August 1931. From 1 October 1932 to 9 January 1935 he was Minister of Agriculture, and the entry credits him with a role in afforesting the Great Plain and in beginning to make the upper Tisza navigable.

body.zh-Hant: 1937年7月31日至1942年4月30日，卡洛伊任國家灌溉局局長。1942年3月9日至1944年3月22日他任首相，3月9日起暫代外交部長，1942年5月20日至1943年7月24日正式兼外交部長。他設法與英美等盟國取得聯繫，以求退出戰爭；1944年3月19日德軍占領匈牙利，他逃入土耳其公使館，直到10月17日。
body.en: From 31 July 1937 to 30 April 1942 Kállay was president of the National Irrigation Office. From 9 March 1942 to 22 March 1944 he was prime minister; from 9 March he was acting foreign minister, and from 20 May 1942 to 24 July 1943 he was also foreign minister. He sought contacts with the Anglo-Saxon powers in order to leave the war; after the German occupation, on 19 March 1944 he took refuge in the Turkish legation, where he stayed until 17 October.

body.zh-Hant: 匈牙利親納粹的箭十字黨人逮捕卡洛伊後，納粹於1945年2月16日把他送往毛特豪森，4月16日至24日轉押達豪，5月初美軍將他救出。戰後他住在卡布里島、羅馬與佛羅倫斯；1953年12月應匈牙利流亡團體之請定居紐約，1967年1月14日在紐約去世。
body.en: After the Arrow Cross men seized him, the Nazis deported Kállay to Mauthausen on 16 February 1945 and to Dachau from 16 to 24 April; American troops freed him in early May. After the war he lived on Capri and in Rome and Florence; in December 1953 he settled in New York at the request of the Hungarian emigré body, and he died there on 14 January 1967.
